function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against backend loan records using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing debt details.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit verification code or birth year provided by the customer.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer into the CRM/LMS.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

ptp_date.description: The agreed payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (ISO 8601), e.g. 2026-08-14

amount.description: The numerical amount in INR the customer committed to pay, e.g. 8499

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered mobile number.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the call or routes account to human agent desk for hardship or debt dispute.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

reason.description: The categorization code for human agent escalation.

summary.description: Brief summary of user's situation or reason for escalation.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs final call outcome and disposition status in the database.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

notes.description: Detailed notes summarizing call outcome, agreements, or customer comments.

function.name: send_whatsapp_message
function.description: Dispatches an interactive WhatsApp Business template message with quick-action buttons (Pay via UPI, Request Extension, Chat with Officer) to borrower's WhatsApp.

function.name: generate_upi_link
function.description: Generates dynamic one-click UPI intent deep-links (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) and dynamic UPI QR code payload.

function.name: schedule_ptp_reminder
function.description: Schedules automated PTP calendar events and SMS/WhatsApp notifications 24h and 2h prior to due date.

function.name: verify_voiceprint
function.description: Executes passive audio voiceprint biometrics matching against caller's registered voice signature.
